def process(waterBodyTesting2019, waterBodyTesting2020, waterBodyTesting2021, waterBodyTesting2022, waterBodyTesting2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = pd.concat(
        [
            waterBodyTesting2019,
            waterBodyTesting2020,
            waterBodyTesting2021,
            waterBodyTesting2022,
            waterBodyTesting2023,
        ],
        ignore_index=True,
    )

    # Standardize key text fields
    for col in ['Community', 'Beach Name']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Some files/years may include "Beach Name" variants (e.g., "Wollaston", "Wollaston Beach - ...").
    # We'll match any beach name containing "wollaston" within Quincy.
    communityMask = df['Community'].astype(str).str.strip().str.casefold() == 'quincy'
    beachMask = df['Beach Name'].astype(str).str.strip().str.casefold().str.contains('wollaston', na=False)
    sub = df.loc[communityMask & beachMask, ['Year', 'Sample Date', 'Community', 'Beach Name', 'Violation']].copy()

    # Swimming standards: Violation == NO (any case). Treat any other value as not meeting.
    sub['violationNorm'] = sub['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.casefold()
    sub['meetsSwimmingStandards'] = sub['violationNorm'].isin(['no'])

    total = len(sub)
    meets = int(sub['meetsSwimmingStandards'].sum())
    pct_int = int(round((meets / total) * 100)) if total > 0 else None

    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                'total_samples': total,
                'meeting_samples': meets,
                'percent_meeting_int': pct_int,
            }
        ]
    )

operators.customDisplayName: Concatenate 2019-2023 water-body-testing tables; filter rows where Community == 'Quincy' (case-insensitive) and Beach Name contains 'wollaston' (case-insensitive substring match to capture naming variants); interpret meeting swimming standards as Violation == 'NO' (case-insensitive); compute total samples, count meeting samples, and integer percent meeting (=round(100*meeting/total)).
